note: What a server sends its player's champion to set how far each spell can be raised, and at which levels. The header names the champion. In the tutorial a client keeps these but uses its own.

items.name: maxRank
items.note: A spell's highest rank, slots 0 to 3 in turn. A client shows zero as one.

fields.name: levels
fields.note: Six per slot, slot 0 first: the level a champion needs to raise that spell from rank 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 in turn.
